subject: whether each operation that keeps a CGEvent fallback performs its function, and no other command, when driven through CGEventChannel alone in ten languages
question: Driven through CGEventChannel alone, with the MIDI key-command approval withdrawn, does each fallback keystroke change the operation's own reading and leave every other reading the harness takes unchanged, in each of Logic's ten languages?

reverify.expected: every row's check passes: the op's reading moves, no other reading moves, and the reply's method is cgevent; the fixture, the operator approvals, 2-Set Korean and Logic's Korean UI are restored
reverify.cost: run as /usr/bin/python3 under 2-Set Korean with LPM_LIVE_LOCK naming a held lock and LPM_EVIDENCE_ROOT an absolute path outside the repository; relaunches Logic once per language, about five minutes per language

method: One run of Scripts/livekit/live_1029_cgevent_fallback_in_every_locale.py at 6d1d97f6af31f595f4e9231533a090673adbc44e in isolated mode drove a debug build (sha256 325486e3c20953b89d2f30068fd48d306bfed5445f036e0be385e59a9125fe03) that carries 6d1d97f6af31f595f4e9231533a090673adbc44e in __TEXT,__lpm_commit, read back by the harness before it drove anything, started with LOGIC_MCP_DEBUG_ONLY_CHANNEL=CGEvent and LOGIC_MCP_DEBUG_ONLY_CHANNEL_PASS naming the reads and setups whose chains hold no CGEvent rung, under the 2-Set Korean input source, with the MIDI key-command approval withdrawn for the run and written back byte for byte. For each language Logic was quit, its AppleLanguages set, and the lpm-locale-campaign fixture, restored with ditto from a copy taken before the run, reopened. Each row ran its setup, read the control-bar checkboxes, track header rows, regions and their selection, the undo title, the playhead's bar, Logic's windows and the structure and sliders the view ops move, sent one command, and read them again. A row passes when the op's own reading moved in the way that names it, no other moved, every reading read, and the reply came through cgevent. Naming is by identity, not by change: an undo item must name the op's own command, with the nouns read from Logic.framework's Localizable.strings for the language; the score editor and the piano roll by the Editors area's tab that reads 1 (StrTabBtnLabel); zoom by the sliders described Vertical Zoom and Horizontal Zoom; automation by the Show/Hide Automation checkbox and the tracks' Automation Mode pop-ups; the bounce dialog by the focused window whose text field ends _bip; pause must leave Play on and the bar held, read twice 2.5 s apart before the call; copy through the paste after it, with the system pasteboard set to text and read back before copy, so only that copy could put a region there; duplicate by the new track carrying the source strip's patch name in the language, read from the Library's Item.strings (InsP/Absolute Zero); close by every fixture window, the Marker List included, gone; a new track's name must carry the audio word or not. Each row's check was recorded right after the row, in its language, against the same row with its after readings replaced by its before readings. edit.quantize has no row: its keystroke is removed in this change (#1094).
conclusion: 440 of 440 checks passed across ten languages.
limits: One Logic installation (12.3, build 6674), one fixture, one keyboard input source (2-Set Korean).
Each row was run once per language; rates were not measured.
The readings are the ones the harness takes; a command that changed something outside them would not be seen.
The pass list widens only reads and setups whose chains hold no CGEvent rung; no operation under test was widened.
Identity is read from the elements and strings named in the method; an editor or dialog that carried the same markers would pass. The editor tab names the editor showing, not what it shows.

The evidence framework's modal snapshot read cannot_tell for 430 of 440 checks: its walk for a sheet met an element whose AXChildren answered -25200 under the views these rows open (editors, mixer, automation lanes). It found no sheet anywhere; the ten checks that read clean are project.close's, taken with the fixture's windows gone. The rows' predicates read their own readings and do not depend on that snapshot.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record states booleans, counts, op names, channel ids and the key letters the harness posted; it quotes no string Logic ships. The localized readings it compared are in the evidence file.
